desc: OpenTrade is a multi‑chain marketplace that tokenizes real‑world assets, allowing institutions to access and trade RWA with on‑chain settlement. It delivers value through fee‑based services and liquidity provision without a native token.

farmingSteps.desc: Analyze fee schedules, revenue sharing, and sustainability without a native token.

farmingSteps.desc: Examine audit reports and verify contract security on multiple chains.
